    "Limited advanced design features for complex branding",
    "Can sometimes feel restrictive for highly unique designs",
    "Reliance on internet connection for full functionality"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The operations manager found Canva to be an incredibly user-friendly and efficient solution for handling their company's design needs, from logos to website elements and various cards. Its vast template library and intuitive interface allowed them to produce professional visuals without requiring specialized design skills. While meeting most of their small business requirements effectively, they occasionally wished for more granular control over specific design elements."
